description: This file defines a React component for selecting refresh frequency options, including preset options and a custom input, with validation and warning functions. It is used in dashboard modal components within Apache Superset.

methods.name: RefreshFrequencySelect
methods.description: React component for selecting refresh frequency, supporting preset options and custom input.

methods.name: validateRefreshFrequency
methods.description: Validates that the selected refresh frequency meets minimum requirements.

methods.name: getRefreshWarningMessage
methods.description: Provides warning message if refresh frequency is below a certain limit.
